notes: Powered 2-way nearfield studio monitor (built-in Class D amps: 20W tweeter / 50W woofer), not rack-mountable (desktop/stand-mounted), so rackUnits omitted. Rear panel also has non-connector controls (Level knob, HF and LF 3-way shelving switches ±2dB, +4dBu/-10dBV input-select switch, power on/off rocker) which are not physical I/O ports and were excluded. The IEC power inlet is the standard 3-conductor IEC-320 type used for detachable AC cords (manual does not further specify C13/C14 designation, but this is the ubiquitous IEC C13/C14 style used on virtually all such gear). Source: official ADAM Audio T-Series (T5V/T7V/T8V) Operation Manual, rear-panel diagram (page 10-11) and audio connections section (page 12), cross-checked against the manufacturer product page (adam-audio.com/en/t-series/t7v/) which corroborates the XLR/RCA input impedances and 132W max power consumption.

ports.name: Bal. in
ports.note: Balanced analog input, +4 dBu nominal, 10 kOhm input impedance. Pin 1 GND, Pin 2 Signal+, Pin 3 Signal-.

ports.name: Unbal. in
ports.note: Unbalanced analog input, -10 dBV nominal, 20 kOhm input impedance. A rear-panel 2-way switch selects which of the two (XLR or RCA) is active.

ports.name: Power
ports.note: Standard 3-prong IEC AC power receptacle (detachable cord). Auto-sensing 100-240V~ 50/60Hz, 132W max. Earthed/grounded mains connection required.
